correspondences.notes: Lacks the REQUIRED *_meg.json (proposed); other sidecars are carried.

brainlife.desc: Raw MEG from a CTF system: one .ds folder per run (.meg4, .res4 and related files), with optional BIDS sidecars.
brainlife.name: neuro/meg/ctf

file_descs.channels: This file is RECOMMENDED as it provides easily searchable information across BIDS datasets for for example, general curation, response to queries or batch analysis. To avoid confusion, the channels SHOULD be listed in the order they appear in the MEG data file. Missing values MUST be indicated with n/a.
file_descs.coordsystem: A JSON document specifying the coordinate system(s) used for the MEG, EEG, head localization coils, and anatomical landmarks.
file_descs.ds: this directory contains various CTF items (.meg4, .res4, .acq, .hc, .hist, ,ec..)
file_descs.headshape: The OPTIONAL digitized positions of the head points. Head shape and electrode description

original.readme:
Each experimental run with a CTF system yields a folder with a .ds extension, containing several files. 

To learn more about CTF’s data organization: 
> https://www.fieldtriptoolbox.org/getting_started/ctf

https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/99-appendices/06-meg-file-formats.html#ctf

brainlife.readme:
Each experimental run with a CTF system yields a folder with a .ds extension, containing several files. 

To learn more about CTF’s data organization: 
> https://www.fieldtriptoolbox.org/getting_started/ctf

https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/99-appendices/06-meg-file-formats.html#ctf

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meg.ctf.json

files.desc: this directory contains various CTF items (.meg4, .res4, .acq, .hc, .hist, ,ec..)
Channel names, types, units and status.
Coordinate system and fiducials for sensor positions.

identifying_risks: CTF .res4/.infods files can hold participant name, run date and operator.
Recording dates and free-text fields in sidecars or events.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 5: raw EEG/MEG headers can hold participant identity and acquisition dates; the more protective tier holds until they are scrubbed.
sharing_cautions: Anonymise headers (e.g. mne-bids anonymize) before sharing outside a controlled project.
tier_conditions: Tier 2 once the CTF header and sidecars are anonymised (no names, birth dates, recording dates).

inputs_of.name: CTF to mne/raw
inputs_of.purpose: converts CTF .ds MEG to MNE raw FIF

inputs_of.name: Split MEG file [ctf]
inputs_of.purpose: splits CTF MEG into two FIF segments

intended_use: Raw CTF MEG input for conversion to MNE raw or splitting into FIF segments.
not_suitable_for: Analysis that needs the BIDS *_meg.json parameters, which this datatype does not carry.
